newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kosonic says talks with investors halted.
newsitem.headline: Kosonic says talks with investors halted.

text.p: Hong Kong's Kosonic International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday discussions between the company and other investors had been terminated.

The company said in a statement it would continue to seek new investors to invest in the company "and to provide interim funding to the company in order to resume production of the company's subsidiaries in Shenzhen".
Kosonic also said it had reached an interim standstill agreement for 45 days with its bankers which would be automatically extended for another 30 days unless terminated by the banks.

Trading in Kosonic shares has been suspended since October 23 due to a temporary halt in production at certain subsidiaries in Shenzhen. Kosonic said trading would remain suspended until further notice.
